Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

Relics and treasures from expeditions you joined or sponsored, carefully cataloged and displayed.

Research: Specialized Lore. The hireling studies treasures of the museum for 7 days and gains knowledge about a question of ancient history as if they had cast Legend Lore, which they share with you the next time you speak with them.

Secrets of the Past. Your Museum holds one treasure that gives you a magical Charm when you study it for 7 days and then finish a Long Rest in your Bastion. The Charm lasts 7 days or until you use it, and you can't gain another from this facility while you have one. Its effect depends on the treasure's origin, chosen below (your DM might add options or limit them to your past expeditions).

  • Charm of Argonnessen: you know Draconic; expend the Charm to cast Dragon's Breath (level 4 version) on yourself only.
  • Charm of Ashtakala: you know Abyssal and Infernal; expend the Charm to cast Ray of Sickness (level 4 version).
  • Charm of Dhakaan: you know Goblin; expend the Charm to cast Staggering Smite.
  • Charm of Khyber: you have Darkvision 120 feet; expend the Charm to gain Truesight 60 feet for 1 minute.
  • Charm of Xen'drik: you know Giant; as a Bonus Action, expend the Charm to make your Strength score 25 for 1 hour.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Museum becomes Vast: it can hold two treasures of different origins and gains two more hirelings, for a total of three.

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
